an4.171:2.3: In this context sampajana doesn’t mean “clear comprehension” as a part of practice. It’s clearly defined in the Vinaya rule for sampajanamusavada: before speaking you know, I will lie, during you know, I am lying, and after you know, I did lie.
an4.171:5.3: Up to here, this discourse is identical with [sn12.25](), which ends at this point. The identity even extends to the ending, which in both cases has a close _-ti_ indicating end of quote. The following portion then begins exactly like a normal Aṅguttara sutta. It seems as if the first portion has been rather clumsily edited in.
